title: Finance Transaction Approval + Posting Governance Hardening
parentBaseline: M3 CLX-031 final HO Tasks acceptance + frozen CLX-032 finance controls

scope.executionGovernance: CLX-030 entitlements and CLX-032 approval limits/delegation/SoD applied to existing GL and Treasury action execution
scope.approvalWorkbench: Single governed queue backed by existing iam_access_reviews
scope.delegation: Effective-date and transaction/office/country-scoped delegation respected; expired delegation rejected
scope.makerChecker: Journal maker self-approval blocked; Treasury payment maker release/pay self-action blocked
scope.executorSeparation: Final approver cannot execute POST/RELEASE/PAY/REVERSE/CLOSE on the same chain
scope.segregationOfDuties: CLX-032 SoD conflicts enforced at approval decision
scope.correctionFlow: Reject, return-for-correction and governed reopen/versioned chain supported
scope.periodClose: Accounting-period close routed through finance governance
scope.arAp: AR/AP approval and write-off execution entitlements added to existing permission catalog
scope.directLinks: Approval workbench stores original finance action target URL
scope.idempotency: Retry of the same resource/action/version reuses the existing approval chain
scope.audit: Immutable IAM audit records request/approve/reject/return/reopen with actor, level and target

evidence.clx031HoTasksRegression: PASS within CLX-033 governed baseline suite
